summary: End-to-end testing of Project Tree & Versioning System (project_tree.py router + ProjectTreePage UI). All 18 backend pytest cases pass (auth, tree, manual snapshots, read snapshot, compare phase/bpmn/edge cases, restore phase/bpmn). Frontend smoke-tested on /projects/5ad98a45-a536-4fd8-a9e0-051f40d26ce4/tree: tree loads with 4 phase sections, A/B compare opens diff panel, View opens snapshot sheet, manual Snapshot button creates v(N+1) and toast, 'Versiones' button on ProjectDetailPage navigates correctly. Auto-snapshot hooks confirmed via code review (ai_generator.py:382 trigger=ai.requirements; specs.py:1207-1218 trigger=ai.speckit). _id leak fix verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML: a <Button data-testid='snapshot-specification-btn'> is rendered INSIDE the collapsible header <button>. React logs hydration error 'In HTML, button cannot be a descendant of button'. Functionality works (e.stopPropagation prevents collapse) but produces console errors and is invalid semantics. Fix: change the outer collapsible wrapper from <button> to a <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick=... onKeyDown=...> (lines 86-111 of ProjectTreePage.jsx).

action_items: (MEDIUM) Refactor PhaseSection header in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectTreePage.jsx (lines 86-111): replace outer <button> with a div+role=button to remove nested-button HTML hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in project_tree.py is correct: /snapshots/compare declared before /snapshots/{snapshot_id} catch-all (verified by tests test_compare_phase + test_compare_same_id_400 + test_compare_unknown_404 all hitting compare path correctly).

_id leak fix verified: all insert_one calls use .copy() (lines 78, 281, 369, 415, 431) and find_one/find use {'_id': 0} projection. Manual snapshot endpoints return JSON-serializable bodies (test_create_bpmn_snapshot_no_id_leak passes).

Auto-snapshot CODE-REVIEW: ai_generator.py:380-392 calls snapshot_spec_full(trigger='ai.requirements') wrapped in try/except (non-fatal). specs.py:1207-1220 inside _run_speckit_llm AFTER speckit_status='ready' update calls snapshot_spec_full(trigger='ai.speckit'), also non-fatal. Both hooks present and correctly placed.
Restore endpoint correctly takes a pre-restore safety snapshot before overwriting (verified: test_restore_phase passes, and tree shows 'Pre-restore' badged rows like v3/v11 from prior runs).
Minor: monotonic versioning uses sort by version desc per (project_id, phase, resource_id) — correct, but consider an index for performance once snapshots accumulate.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/dev-login (no body) -> session_token used as Bearer.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_pytest_spec/TEST_pytest_bpmn snapshots and several extra v8-v12 manual snapshots on project 5ad98a45 / spec lti-spec-onboarding / diagram 0dac3518 during testing. Restore tests also created pre-restore + restore versions. These add to the visible tree but do not corrupt prior data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_project_tree.py is reusable for regression — uses dev-login + LTI project. Frontend ProjectTreePage works end-to-end; only outstanding issue is nested <button> in PhaseSection header (medium priority cosmetic/console error, no functional impact). LLM endpoints (/generate-requirements, /generate-speckit) NOT exercised per instruction; their auto-snapshot hooks were verified by source review only.
rca of the issue: Nested <button> warning RCA: ProjectTreePage.jsx line 86 wraps the entire phase header in a <button type='button'> for collapse toggle, but inside that header (line 98) it conditionally renders a shadcn <Button data-testid='snapshot-specification-btn'> — shadcn Button renders a native <button>. Solution: convert the outer toggle to a div with role='button' and onKeyDown for Enter/Space, or move the Snapshot button outside the toggle <button> (e.g., next to ChevronDown).
